summary: The proposal is well structured and otherwise satisfies the requirements for objectives, bibliography, figures, AI transparency, and schedule quality. The main issue is that the Problem section briefly presents a workaround or alternative instead of restricting itself to the problem and its negative consequences; revise this before submission.

findings.title: Remove the Alternative Solution from the Problem Section
findings.description: The Problem section includes an alternative access-management approach rather than only describing the problem and its consequences. Remove this solution-oriented sentence or recast it solely as a negative consequence, such as maintainers receiving excessive privileges under current practices.

locations.quote: The **common workaround hands maintainers full administrative rights**, which violates the principle of least privilege [SS75] and exposes every user and every host to a mistake made for a single project.
